authority.confirmed_family_action: 4D geodesic-plane transit with higher-order gradient correction that preferentially follows favorable gravitational/equipotential and higher-dimensional shear terrain rather than imposing a Metric, Fold, Manifold, Slipstream, Lattice, Gate, or Phase solution.

mathematics.state: Represent transit-relevant gravity as a time-dependent terrain reconstructed from visible mass, effective dark-matter projection, local tidal Hessian, higher-dimensional shear, branch topology, and uncertainty. The skimmer solves for an admissible moving route through that terrain rather than creating an arbitrary scalar speed.
mathematics.terrain_state: T_g={Phi_eff, grad Phi_eff, H(Phi_eff), S_AB, grad S_AB, dS_AB/dt, K_branch, Sigma_terrain}.
mathematics.route_functional: Gamma*=argmin_Gamma integral_Gamma [w0 + wg C_grad + wt C_tidal + ws C_shear + wu C_uncertainty + wf C_fork + wx C_switch] ds, subject to coupling, structure, sensing, and abort constraints.
mathematics.route_gain: chi_g=D0/D_g where D_g is the generalized terrain-weighted route cost; chi_g is not a literal velocity multiplier.
mathematics.fork_ambiguity: A_f=1-max_i p_i for branch probabilities p_i. A fork is unsafe when ambiguity, branch divergence rate, remaining decision time, and recoupling authority jointly exceed certified bounds.
mathematics.branch_separation: D_branch(t)=||x_1(t)-x_2(t)|| in the locally reconstructed transit geometry; a rising dD_branch/dt increases commitment urgency.
mathematics.switch_cost: C_switch penalizes transitions between shear/equipotential branches according to required recoupling impulse, field realignment, structural load, and reference covariance.
mathematics.safety_horizon: L_sensor >= v_eff(t_detect+t_solve+t_command+t_recouple+t_exit)+D_margin; sensor horizon must cover branch detection and safe de-transit/recoupling, not merely obstacle detection.
mathematics.structural_margin: mu_struct=1-max_x(sigma_equiv/sigma_allow); positive margin is required during nominal coupling, branch transfer, and emergency de-transit.
mathematics.efficiency_model: eta_g is comparatively improved by favorable terrain alignment and degraded by hostile gradients, branch switching, uncertainty, and excessive corrective coupling; coefficients remain PROPOSED until calibrated.
hard_constraints: the selected branch must remain reconstructable at the required epoch
branch ambiguity and predicted divergence must remain below certified commitment thresholds
whole-vessel coupling and structural margins must stay positive
sensor/solver/recoupling horizon must exceed the emergency decision horizon
gravity may be useful terrain but proximity to severe gravity can still make a route impossible
a favorable gradient may reduce route burden while a fork or steep Hessian simultaneously increases hazard

path_progression.mathematical_capability: Follow one fixed, heavily surveyed scalar-potential corridor with no meaningful branch autonomy.
changed_limits: repeatable coupling to one known rail
path_progression.operational_result: Demonstrates terrain-assisted transit only on a narrowly certified fixed route.

path_progression.mathematical_capability: Estimate local gradient direction and remain coupled to one changing equipotential/shear feature.
changed_limits: reduced dependence on fixed external geometry
path_progression.operational_result: Can actively skim a local gravitational feature rather than merely traverse a precomputed rail.

path_progression.mathematical_capability: Solve the coupled terrain of multiple major bodies and maintain a vessel-scale branch solution through barycentric geometry.
path_progression.operational_result: Operates through complex system-scale gravitational geometry with bounded branch choices.

path_progression.mathematical_capability: Predict the time evolution of interstellar shear planes and carry a branch solution beyond immediate local sensing.
path_progression.operational_result: First practical interstellar terrain-following transit under large safety margins and conservative fork rejection.

path_progression.mathematical_capability: Represent the route as a graph of admissible terrain branches and optimize transfers among them under dynamic uncertainty.
path_progression.operational_result: Routine interstellar service across heterogeneous gravitational terrain rather than a single corridor.

path_progression.mathematical_capability: Infer weakly observed higher-dimensional channels/ridges from lensing, residual gravity, historical route data, and remote references.
path_progression.operational_result: Extends strategic range by understanding and exploiting more of the gravitational terrain, not simply by increasing power.

path_progression.mathematical_capability: Continuously co-solve higher-dimensional terrain, branch probabilities, vessel disturbance, structural state, and receding-horizon route choice in real time.
path_progression.operational_result: Mature gravitic transit capable of exploiting transient channels and avoiding developing forks while retaining finite sensing, structure, and gravity limits.

blocks.energy_conditioning: Supplies coupling, steering, recoupling, sensor, and reserve energy; favorable terrain lowers corrective burden but never removes reserve requirements.
blocks.prime_mover: Creates controllable coupling between vessel and selected gravitational/shear terrain mode.
blocks.field_formation: Distributed coupling surfaces, rings, membranes, organs, lattice regions, or nodes that keep the whole protected vessel attached to one admissible branch.
blocks.transit_control: Allocates coupling authority, predicts branch evolution, and executes branch transfer or de-transit before ambiguity becomes catastrophic.
blocks.navigation_sensing: Gradiometry, lensing/timing observations, terrain inversion, branch classification, reference fusion, and occupancy/exclusion sensing.
blocks.termination_recovery: Controlled decoupling from transit terrain, ordinary-space reacquisition, load relaxation, and reserve-powered stabilization.
blocks.whole_effect_coverage: Certified coupling envelope must cover the complete vessel and all appendages whose differential response could tear the structure apart.
blocks.backbone: Timing, structural load distribution, thermal transport, sensor fusion, branch voting, safety interlocks, and distributed abort command.

layout_invariants: gravitic coupling must be spatially distributed enough to prevent destructive differential acceleration across the vessel
navigation sensing requires physically meaningful baselines and cannot be reduced to a cockpit computer
branch voting and de-transit authority require protected redundancy
structural paths must tolerate transient asymmetric loads during fork rejection and branch transfer

precommit: authenticate terrain epoch and source covariance
solve at least one safe route plus escape solution
in_transit: monitor divergence rate and tidal Hessian
fork_procedure: rank branches by posterior probability and survival margin
reject branches with insufficient recoupling time
transfer only while whole-vessel coupling remains certified
de-transit when no branch meets minimum confidence and recovery margin
termination: move toward low-burden ordinary-space reacquisition volume
verify ordinary gravity solution and structural residuals
operation.operator_rule: Do not chase a locally favorable gradient when branch confidence, tidal load, or remaining abort horizon has fallen below certification.

periodic: validate terrain-model residuals against independent observations
maintenance.diagnostic_order: reference/ephemeris error -> gravimetry/lensing disagreement -> terrain-inversion error -> branch-classification/solver error -> coupling-sector mismatch -> structural deformation -> energy/recovery defect -> prime mover defect
maintenance.return_to_service: A repaired installation must reproduce certified terrain reconstruction, branch classification, coupling symmetry, structural margin, sensor horizon, and emergency de-transit on independent test geometry.

signatures.generator_rule: The universal signature is interaction with gravitational/shear terrain; carrier, spectrum, observability, and thermal expression depend on embodiment and Path level.

failures.catastrophic_chain_example: unmodeled terrain knot -> posterior splits across two branches -> branch divergence rises faster than solver convergence -> sectors begin following inconsistent solutions -> differential load grows -> hull/coupling geometry departs certification -> if recoupling/de-transit horizon is exhausted, structural disassembly follows.
failures.root_cause_rule: A fork loss must distinguish bad source data, inadequate sensing, wrong terrain inversion, solver/classifier defect, coupling hardware, structure, command latency, and recovery shortage rather than reporting generic navigation error.

scaling.vessel_size: Larger vessels gain sensor baseline but face larger differential gravity, structural span, synchronization delay, coupling area, and abort energy; scaling is therefore non-monotonic.
scaling.drive_size: Larger coupling arrays can follow weaker or more complex terrain but increase branch-transfer inertia, timing complexity, and structural burden.
scaling.sensor_baseline: Longer baselines generally improve gradient/shear reconstruction until timing, structural flexure, and calibration errors dominate.
scaling.multi_drive: Multiple gravitic drives must be classified as coherent sectors, redundant couplers, branch-transfer auxiliaries, or independent installations; their route authority does not add linearly.

technology_basis_translation.TERRESTRIAL_MECHANICAL: Distributed gravimeters/lensing sensors, precision clocks, field/coupling rings or plates, electronic/photonic branch solvers, reinforced trusses and pumped thermal loops.
technology_basis_translation.AQUATIC_FLUIDIC: Pressure-qualified gradient membranes, wet-photonic timing, hydroacoustic/optical baseline metrology, fluid-compatible distributed coupling and cavitation-aware load routing.
technology_basis_translation.CRYOGENIC_SUPERCONDUCTING: Persistent-current coupling structures, ultra-stable cryogenic gravimetry, superconducting timing distribution, quench-isolated recoupling reserve.
technology_basis_translation.GAS_GIANT_BUOYANT: Large buoyant sensor baselines, distributed flexible coupling structures, atmospheric reference arrays, convective thermal management and tension-dominant load paths.
technology_basis_translation.BIOLOGICAL_SYMBIOTIC: Cultivated gradient-sensing organs, distributed neural branch voting, compliant field-bearing tissue and regenerative coupling structures; no race ownership is implied.
technology_basis_translation.MINERAL_CRYSTALLINE: Resonant crystalline gradiometers, coherent lattice coupling volumes, optical/acoustic branch sensing, prestressed fracture-tolerant load paths.
technology_basis_translation.POSTMATERIAL_DISTRIBUTED: Distributed reference nodes, continuous terrain tomography, executable branch proofs, topology-preserving state transfer among coupling nodes and authenticated fallback states.

hard_guards: never substitute Metric, Fold, Manifold, Slipstream, Q-Lattice, Gate, or Phase mathematics
never infer race/manufacturer ownership from technology basis
never promote DERIVED terrain inversion equations or PROPOSED coefficients to CONFIRMED canon
never collapse a fork into a generic speed penalty
never claim that stronger gravity is universally better for the skimmer
never permit a branch whose sensing, coupling, structure, or de-transit constraints fail
preserve higher-authority named source values and report runtime conflicts rather than silently normalizing them

provenance.canon_rule: Confirmed family identity, recovered Path implementation names, and the adopted higher-dimensional gravitational-terrain premise are preserved. Exact estimators, coefficients, branch thresholds, procedures, and technology translations remain DERIVED or PROPOSED unless higher authority adopts them.
provenance.origin_note: This volume implements the legacy requirement for gravity-sensitive, family-distinct transit with explicit fork danger, safety lookahead, mathematics, equipment, training, maintenance, and incremental technical development while avoiding fabricated races, manufacturers, inventors, dates, or historical incidents.
